# DATA
## HISTORICAL
### TURNOUT
```{r}
historical_turnout <- read_csv("../data/processed/historical_midterm_turnout.csv")
```
### DEMOGRAPHICS
```{r}
historical_demographics <- read_csv("../data/processed/historical_demographics.csv")
```



### COMBINE
```{r}
historical_data <- historical_turnout |>
  left_join(historical_demographics, join_by(year, county)) |>
  filter(party == "ALL")

remove(historical_turnout, historical_demographics)
```

## 2026
### ELIGIBLE
```{r}
eligible_voters_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_eligible_voters.csv")
```

### EARLY
```{r}
early_voting_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_early_voting.csv")
```

### DEMOGRAPHICS
```{r}
demographics_2026 <- read_csv("../data/processed/2026_demographics.csv")
```

### COMBINE
```{r}
data_2026 <- eligible_voters_2026 |>
  left_join(early_voting_2026, join_by(year, county, eligible_voters)) |>
  left_join(demographics_2026, join_by(year, county)) |>
  filter(party == "ALL")

remove(eligible_voters_2026, early_voting_2026, demographics_2026)
```


# FINAL MODEL

```{r}
final_fit <- glm(
  cbind(turnout, eligible_voters - turnout) ~ pct_black + pct_early + median_household_income,
  family = quasibinomial, 
  data = historical_data
)
summary(final_fit)
```

## PREDICTED

```{r}
predicted <- data_2026 |>
  mutate(
    predicted_pct_turnout = predict(final_fit, newdata = data_2026, type = "response"),
    predicted_turnout   = predicted_pct_turnout * eligible_voters,
    prior_midterm_pct_turnout = historical_data$pct_turnout[historical_data$year == 2022]
  ) |>
  select(year, county, eligible_voters, predicted_turnout, predicted_pct_turnout, prior_midterm_pct_turnout)
```


## BACKTEST
```{r}
f <- cbind(turnout, eligible_voters - turnout) ~ pct_black + pct_early + median_household_income

backtest <- map(c("2010", "2014", "2018", "2022"), \(h) {
  fit <- glm(f, family = quasibinomial, weights = eligible_voters,
             data = filter(historical_data, year != h))
  filter(historical_data, year == h) |>
    mutate(predicted = predict(fit, pick(everything()), type = "response"))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  select(year, county, pct_turnout, predicted) |>
  mutate(miss = predicted - pct_turnout)

q <- quantile(backtest$pct_turnout - backtest$predicted, c(0.05, 0.95))
```

## CONFIDENCE
```{r}
predicted <- predicted |>
  mutate(lo_pct = predicted_pct_turnout + q[1],
         hi_pct = predicted_pct_turnout + q[2],
         lo = lo_pct * eligible_voters,
         hi = hi_pct * eligible_voters) |>
  select(year, county, eligible_voters, predicted_turnout, predicted_pct_turnout, lo, lo_pct, hi, hi_pct, prior_midterm_pct_turnout) |>
  mutate(across(c(predicted_pct_turnout, lo_pct, hi_pct, prior_midterm_pct_turnout), ~ round(.x * 100, 1)),
         across(c(predicted_turnout, lo, hi), ~ round(.x, 0)))

predicted |> summarise(statewide = sum(predicted_turnout) / sum(eligible_voters))

write_csv(predicted, "../data/processed/2026_predicted_turnout.csv")
```
